title: Coni's Crates Redux
description: Coni's Crates is a small, vanilla styled storage and processing mod.
body:
Coni's Crates is a small processing and storage mod with a vanilla style. The mod "Classic Pipes" is reccomended to be used with this, but is not required as hoppers work just fine.

There are 5 storage crates and 3 processing crates:
1. Wooden Crate (27 slots)
2. Copper Crate (45 slots)
3. Iron Crate (57 slots)
4. Golden Crate (75 slots)
5. Diamond Crate (108 slots)
6. Trash Crate (permanently deletes items)
7. Smelting Crate (instantaneously smelts smeltable items)
8. Resin Crate (repairs tools passed through it)

Crates cannot be accessed via  GUI, it must be accessed via hoppers or pipes.
